title: The Hollow Hour
style: hand-painted 2D horror animation with visible ink texture, desaturated teal and sodium-orange palette, deep crushed blacks, volumetric fog, harsh practical light sources, slow deliberate camera moves, unsettling negative space, no photoreal people, no gore, no comedy
sheet_style: hand-painted 2D horror animation character sheet, consistent line work, muted palette, neutral dark-grey background, soft rim light, 8k, no text

characters.name: Mara
characters.look: a 19-year-old night-shift petrol station attendant, small and wiry, dark curly hair tied back, pale olive skin, a faded green hoodie under a red staff tabard, a torch clipped to her belt, dark circles under wary eyes
characters.ability: notices small wrong details: a footprint, a dead dial tone, a shadow with no owner
characters.personality: quiet, stubborn, keeps her fear behind her teeth

characters.name: The Hollow Man
characters.look: an impossibly tall man in a long wet charcoal coat, narrow shoulders, a smooth featureless face with no eyes or mouth, skin the colour of old paper, long arms that hang past his knees, bare feet, always slightly out of focus
characters.ability: moves only while the lights flicker; between flickers he holds the exact same pose and is closer
poses: standing at the edge of the light

scenes.name: Last Stop Petrol Station
scenes.look: an isolated rural petrol station at 3 AM, two pumps under buzzing sodium lights, cracked concrete forecourt, fog between pine trees, a failing red sign, a small shop with fogged glass and one fluorescent tube, wet tyre marks, no other cars
